verdict.rationale: Claude Code exposes broad programmatic access via the Agent SDK ('full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions'), the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY direct API path, headless/CI usage (pipes, GitHub Actions), and even an MCP-server mode (`claude mcp serve`), suggesting most CLI/UI capabilities can be driven programmatically. However, there is no explicit documentation stating full feature parity between the UI (web/mobile/IDE features like Remote Control, Agent view, visual diff review) and the API/SDK, and some UI-only conveniences (interactive diff viewer, mobile teleport) aren't confirmed as API-accessible. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, evidence that UI-exclusive features (visual diffs, remote control, agent view) are reachable via API, independent confirmation of SDK completeness.
